items.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
items.description: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
items.description: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
items.description: A temporary ceasefire has brought rare quiet to Kherson, offering its residents a glimpse of normal life before fighting resumes.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
items.description: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
items.description: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

items.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
items.description: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

items.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
items.description: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.

items.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
items.description: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

items.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering
items.description: Xi's anti-corruption campaign has become "an effort to consolidate and maintain authority", observers say.

items.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
items.description: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.

items.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
items.description: The Republican governor was responding to allegations in the New York Times that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate, Dan Sullivan.

items.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
items.description: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.
